title: Shared Node Identity and Transport Contract

preflight.note: Created before any shared crate extraction, identity convergence, or transport contract work started.

acceptance_criteria.text: Record the shared-crate boundary: what the crate owns (node identity, canonical envelope, transport contract) and what it must never import (store, rqlite, policy, cluster, failover, or any connectivity backend).
Create the companion governed work item in the canonical in-tree ForgeWire Fabric implementation before any Fabric-side change, per the work item 037 cross-repo rule.
Extract a shared ed25519 node identity crate with a deterministic key and serialization contract, proving no private key material appears in serialized output, diagnostics, or logs.

Converge ForgeLink node identity onto the shared crate without regressing shipped work item 031 LNH-001 desktop vault behavior, sequenced so in-flight LNH-001 desktop slices are not rewritten mid-flight.
Prove the crate is consumable from both the ForgeLink Tauri shell and the Fabric workspace with a pinned version and reproducible builds on both sides.
Define the bounded authenticated transport as a versioned trait or contract with no connectivity backend, sufficient to satisfy the interface need of work item 031 LNH-007.
Provide a loopback or LAN reference implementation of the transport contract for tests only, explicitly not an off-LAN connectivity path.
Prove the contract admits only approved metadata classes and that private communication data remains inexpressible through it until work item 031 LNH-013 is recorded with evidence.
Define the shared crate release and versioning contract, including semantic versioning, changelog, and the pinning policy each consumer follows.
Document the boundary and record a threat note covering identity convergence and key handling, making no claim of off-LAN connectivity.
Prove this item does not block or regress work items 031, 032, and 037, and that ForgeLink builds and ships unchanged if the shared crate is not adopted.
